calls.objective: Integrate all visible evidence into one complete executable policy state whose initial commitments have an inspectable causal relationship to the anchor, contract, constraints, hypothesis, and loop structure.

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion can prohibit commitments but cannot reset the shared causal basis of an already complete executable artifact.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This adds a post-construction causal-state reset absent from exclusion authority, ownership transfer, semantic closure, provenance defeasibility, serialization, and exclusion projection; it is not a reviewer, gate, role split, field, or rename.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: The emitted policy remains one complete artifact while commitments supported only by the contradicted shared premise cease to govern it.
mode_certificate.state_transition: The single artifact transitions from anchor-continuous grounding to contract-and-constraint grounding, with the contradicted premise losing causal authority before emission.
mode_certificate.trigger: A successor-visible contradiction between an explicit contract or constraint obligation and a shared anchor-derived premise supporting multiple commitments in the predecessor artifact.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the static exclusion-analysis edge with one executable causal-state edge whose successor can reset the artifact's governing basis when post-construction reconciliation exposes that contradiction.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The lineage can coherently decommit from a stale premise family while retaining one directly executable artifact and preserving contract-grounded completeness.
